text:
phil: quick check — found a dangling anchor on the deploy checklist page; link to /guides/deploy#rollout-schedule 404s.
anya: thanks for flagging. who owns the deploy checklist today?
kevin: that's on my plate but i'm OOO tomorrow. can you paste the exact heading text?
phil: heading reads 'Rollout schedule & windows' so the fragment should be `#rollout-schedule-windows`. i'm planning a tiny PR to: (1) update the fragment, (2) add a one-line note about scheduling windows (use explicit UTC ranges), and (3) add a small linkcheck test.
kevin: perfect, ping me on the PR. if CI is green i'll merge once i'm back. small nit: please spell out 'UTC' once in the note.
linkbot: created task docs:linkfix-9001 "deploy-checklist anchor + schedule note" assigned to @kevin, reported by @phil
phil: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1202 — includes the anchor fix and linkcheck test. tagging @kevin and @anya for a quick review.
anya: skim looks good to me; left a tiny wording nit on the schedule sentence. @kevin if you want i can do a follow-up while you're out.
kevin: thanks @anya — go ahead if it's blocking; otherwise i'll tidy it next week. thanks @phil for catching this :pray: 
phil: i'll wait 24 hours then either merge the nit or add a follow-up commit. also doing a repo grep for other '#rollout-schedule' fragments across i18n and playbooks.
kevin: appreciate it — if you find other occurrences, add them as separate commits in the same PR so review stays small.
